basic_details.job_title: JNCASR Junior Research Fellow I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Molecular Biology and Genetics Unit (MBGU) of Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Bengaluru, an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India (a Deemed University), has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow -I [JRF] on the "Center of Marine Therapeutics (CMT)" project under Prof. Ravi Manjithaya. The remuneration is Rs. 37,000 plus 30% HRA, and the appointment is purely temporary for six months only. Applicants need a post graduate degree in life sciences/biotechnology and must be within the maximum age limit

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted by email. Send them to Prof. Ravi Manjithaya, Autophagy Lab, MBGU, at [email protected], latest by 21/11/2026. The application form is available on the JNCASR website. Candidates must give their email address and mobile number.
Scanned copy of updated CV / brief resume
Scanned copies of relevant certificates in support of educational qualifications, experience and qualifying examinations
important_instructions: The position is temporary and for six months only. Candidates are required to provide their email address and mobile number. Only shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR)

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research is an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, and a Deemed University. The notice gives its address as Jakkur Post, Bengaluru - 560 064, India. The post sits in the Molecular Biology and Genetics Unit, in the Autophagy Lab led by Prof. Ravi Manjithaya.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following experience under the post: Experience in molecular biology techniques, like PCR, DNA/RNA isolation, transfection and immunocytochemistry. Familiarity with mammalian cell culture, protein analysis techniques such as SDS-PAGE and Western blotting, and basic biochemical assays are desirable. Experience in fluorescence microscopy and image analysis (ImageJ/ Imaris/CellProfiler). The maximum age limit is 28 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.essential_qualification: Post graduate degree in life sciences/ biotechnology. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Test- CSIR UGC NET (LS) or GATE.
rows.desirable: Preference to candidates with prior research experience, and to those with strong verbal and written communication and cooperation in teamwork.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Junior Research Fellow -I [JRF] post is Rs. 37,000 plus 30% HRA. The appointment is purely on a temporary basis for a period of six months only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Junior Research Fellow -I [JRF]
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email. Send them to Prof. Ravi Manjithaya, Autophagy Lab, MBGU, at [email protected] , latest by 21/11/2026. The application form is available on the JNCASR website. Candidates must give their email address and mobile number. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview. The notice does not give an interview date or describe how shortlisting is done.

content_sections.text: The position is temporary and for six months only. Candidates are required to provide their email address and mobile number. Only shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview.
